2577-4826-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-4826-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

193-2369-2724-3217.description:
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

661-3685-4659-7356.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Longshot. 
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Sculpting Steel, and choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4605-4681-5147-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6835-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

514-654-2438-5944.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-5793-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.
1978-5793-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

339-677-2079-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Temur Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

104-5641-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-5641-5789.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with one to three time counters on it

1618-2092-2585-2806.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying at most {1}, removing three time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Reality Strobe, returning Grim Monolith from the battlefield to your hand, and then exiling Reality Strobe with three time counters on it.
Repeat.

345-4929-5224.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Together Forever, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

719-1429-4050-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
719-1429-4050-5402.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding one mana of any color.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

678-1477-4766.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken artifact creature you control.
678-1477-4766.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact / Creature with "{T}: Add Mana" that can tap upon ETB (Mana Rock)

1170-1395-5078--30.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the mana-producing artifact or creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten and Elsha of the Infinite's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking the mana-producing artifact or creature.
Resolve the Elsha of the Infinite trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-1115-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-1115-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1269-2034-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cormela, adding {C}{C}.
When Cormela dies, it triggers, returning Exhume from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Exhume by paying {1}{B}, causing each player to return a creature card from their graveyard to the battlefield, with you choosing to return Cormela.
Repeat.

643-1887-2060-4222-5121.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Urtet.
Urtet does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
643-1887-2060-4222-5121.description:
Activate Urtet by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, putting six +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, as they are all Myrs due to Maskwood Nexus.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Urtet.
Repeat.

2011-2837-3049-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela and Sophina do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other nontoken creatures that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
2011-2837-3049-4050.description:
Declare Najeela, Sophina, and at least three other nontoken creatures as attackers.
Sophina and Najeela trigger.
Resolve the Sophina trigger, creating at least five 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste or five 3/1 Dog creature tokens due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five creature tokens, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

893-1651-2557.description:
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Myr tokens, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.

2713-4289-4385-5153.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
2713-4289-4385-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {1}.
Pay {1} to create a 1/1 Sliver token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
